# Close wrap, Mon 2026-10-26

1. **Indexes snapped a two-week skid.** Nasdaq +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.7%, Dow +0.3% ([Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-10262026-12194076); [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-rally-as-investors-parse-anthropic-ipo-filing-busy-week-of-tech-earnings-153428995.html)). Driver: Anthropic's S-1 (Nasdaq: ANT; H1 revenue $16.3B, $80.7B loss) revived the AI trade; semis index +3%+ and tech/discretionary led at midday, with LITE, COHR, DELL, HPE among top gainers ([Reuters via StreetInsider](https://www.streetinsider.com/Market+Check/Wall+St+rises+as+Anthropics+IPO+filing+sharpens+focus+on+AI+trade/27230086.html)).
2. **Oil eased:** WTI −2.1% to ~$101, Brent under $115 as mediators went to Tehran; 10y ~4.98% ([Bloomberg via Swissinfo](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/stocks-climb-as-anthropic-files-for-ipo%3B-oil-falls%3A-markets-wrap/92273033)). Headwind for SLB/HAL/XLE/LMT/RTX holds.
3. **Covered names:** TSLA +6.3% midday on Barclays upgrade ([Reuters](https://www.streetinsider.com/Market+Check/Wall+St+rises+as+Anthropics+IPO+filing+sharpens+focus+on+AI+trade/27230086.html)); INTC +6% on New Street Buy, earnings Thu ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2114773315797631046)); VZ ~flat at $44 as Starlink Mobile worries offset the beat ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/25/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)); META seeking up to $95B equity raise; EQT buying RRC in ~$12.8B all-stock deal ([Swissinfo](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/stocks-climb-as-anthropic-files-for-ipo%3B-oil-falls%3A-markets-wrap/92273033)).
4. **After hours:** CDNS Q3 rev $1.633B (+22%), non-GAAP EPS $2.11, FY rev guide raised to $6.387–6.417B, record $8.2B backlog, +$2.5B buyback ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CDNS/cadence-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-h0q5a27erq44.html)); closed $322.17, ~+1.9% AH ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/CDNS/)).
5. **Tomorrow:** durable goods 8:30, Conf. Board confidence and new home sales 10:00; KO, UPS, PYPL BMO; V, HOOD AMC. FOMC Wed.

Signals: expired semis/AI-capex, TSLA, META, IBM, ABT, ROL, LVS avoids dropped (group rallied today); AI-infra (CRWV, NBIS, ORCL, IREN), telco, airline avoids stay.

## Swing idea
- **CDNS** long, low. Clean beat-and-raise with small AH gap (fits our beat-and-raise lesson); log from today's close. Risk: margins down y/y, rich valuation, choppy AI/semis tape into MSFT/GOOGL.
